title: current-page parser carries unscheduled and announced
instruction: In outside_calendar.py, parse_fomc_calendars still appends date and kind only. Add unscheduled=False and announced=schedule_published(day) to each row, and return columns date, kind, unscheduled, announced. Match what parse_fomc_historical now does. Tests must stay green.

title: schedule_published helper and release_schedule ledger
instruction: Add def schedule_published(day) returning pd.Timestamp(year=day.year-1, month=SCHEDULE_PUBLISH_MONTH, day=SCHEDULE_PUBLISH_DAY). Rewrite release_schedule to take announced=None, default each scheduled row to schedule_published(day), let an announced mapping override, and give each cancellation its own record with a source column of ledger or fallback. Return columns announced, scheduled, status, source.

title: forward_release_distance per row
instruction: Add forward_release_distance(sessions, schedule) returning a float array of per-row distance to the next announced release. Scan sessions in order, absorb announcements whose announced date is on or before the row, keep a heap of known future sessions, and pop entries that are past or now cancelled. A row must never see a later announcement. Keep forward_releases for compatibility.

title: month-end helpers
instruction: Add _later_weekday_in_month(day) and _month_end_sessions(sessions). A session is month-end only when the next session is in a later month, or it is the last row and no weekday remains in that month. Compute it on the full index, never on the truncated rows.

title: build_calendar wiring
instruction: Add cpi_announced and jobs_announced parameters. Add _meeting_ledger(fomc, sessions) building announced, scheduled, status rows where an unscheduled meeting is announced on its own date and a scheduled one on schedule_published. Switch days_to_fomc, days_to_cpi and days_to_jobs to forward_release_distance. Switch is_month_end to _month_end_sessions(sessions) and drop the unused size line.

title: six tests
instruction: Append to tests/test_outside_calendar.py: (1) a half-finished month is not month-end and stabilises once finished; (2) an unscheduled meeting is invisible before it is called and a scheduled one is visible ahead; (3) a cancellation drops the date only from its announcement date; (4) a bare cancellation date is marked fallback; (5) a late announcement is invisible to an earlier row; (6) a scheduled release is announced by the schedule not the previous release. Each test names its James finding in a comment.

title: dispatch and read the run
instruction: Dispatch outside-event-calendar on the branch, read the runs list for the branch, and append the run id plus the days_to_cpi and days_to_jobs coverage rows to agent/JOURNAL.md. Then task_complete.
